title.hg: Screen Pe Sab Real Nahi Hota

subtitle.en: Filters, ads, influencers and what to do when something online feels wrong
subtitle.hg: Filters, ads, influencers — aur jab online kuch galat lage toh kya karein

hook.en: That glowing skin in the ad? It took a make-up artist, studio lights, fifty retakes and an editing app. Screens show a polished version of life, not the real one.
hook.hg: Ad wali woh glowing skin? Uske peeche makeup artist, studio lights, pachaas retakes aur ek editing app hai. Screen life ka polished version dikhati hai, asli wala nahi.

objectives.en: Explain how photos and videos are staged, filtered or edited before you see them.
objectives.hg: Samjha paana ki photos aur videos tum tak pahunchne se pehle kaise stage, filter aur edit hote hain.

objectives.en: Spot when a post is trying to sell you something.
objectives.hg: Pehchaan paana ki koi post tumhe kuch bechne ki koshish kar rahi hai.

objectives.en: Know what to do if you see content online that is meant for adults or feels upsetting.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki agar online adults ke liye bana ya upset karne wala content dikh jaaye toh kya karna hai.

h.en: The perfect photo is a team project
h.hg: Perfect photo poori team ka kaam hai

body.en: Almost every picture you see in an ad, a film poster or a popular reel has been worked on. Good lighting, make-up, a carefully chosen camera angle and dozens of retakes come first. Then filters and editing apps smooth skin, change body shape, brighten eyes and remove pimples, scars and body hair. Even ordinary people take twenty selfies and post one. So when you compare your everyday face or body with a picture on a screen, you are comparing a real person with a finished product. Real skin has pores, marks and hair. That is not a flaw; that is skin.
body.hg: Ad ho, film poster ho ya popular reel — jo bhi photo dikhti hai, lagbhag har ek pe pehle kaam hua hota hai. Pehle aati hai achhi lighting, makeup, soch-samajh ke chuna hua camera angle aur dozens of retakes. Phir filters aur editing apps skin smooth karte hain, body shape badalte hain, aankhein bright karte hain aur pimples, scars aur body hair gayab kar dete hain. Normal log bhi bees selfie leke ek hi post karte hain. Toh jab tum apne roz ke chehre ya body ko screen wali photo se compare karte ho, tum ek real insaan ko ek finished product se compare kar rahe ho. Real skin mein pores, marks aur baal hote hain. Yeh flaw nahi hai; skin aisi hi hoti hai.

h.en: Who is paying for this post?
h.hg: Is post ke paise kaun de raha hai?

body.en: Ads are made to sell things, and they work by making you feel that something is missing: fairer skin, a slimmer body, cooler shoes. Influencers are people with many followers, and brands often pay them or send free products so that they will praise them. In India such posts are supposed to carry labels like 'ad', 'sponsored' or 'paid partnership', but the label can be tiny or missing. A useful habit: before you believe a post, ask who made it, what they want you to do or buy, and what they left out.
body.hg: Ads cheezein bechne ke liye bante hain, aur woh tumhe yeh feel karake kaam karte hain ki tum mein kuch kami hai: gori skin, patli body, zyada cool shoes. Influencers woh log hain jinke bahut followers hote hain, aur brands aksar unhe paise dete hain ya free products bhejte hain taaki woh tareef karein. India mein aisi posts pe 'ad', 'sponsored' ya 'paid partnership' jaisa label hona chahiye, lekin label bahut chhota ho sakta hai ya hota hi nahi. Ek kaam ki aadat: kisi post pe bharosa karne se pehle pucho — isse kisne banaya, yeh mujhse kya karwana ya kharidwana chahte hain, aur inhone kya chhupa liya.

h.en: Apps are built to keep you scrolling
h.hg: Apps bane hi aise hain ki tum scroll karte raho

body.en: Video and game apps use a computer system called an algorithm. It watches what you tap, like and pause on, then shows you more of the same so that you stay longer. That is why one cricket clip turns into an hour of clips. It also means shocking, scary or exaggerated videos spread fast, because people stop to look at them. A video having lakhs of views does not make it true. For questions about health, your body or growing up, check with a parent, teacher, doctor or another trusted source instead of trusting whatever appears next in your feed.
body.hg: Video aur game apps ek computer system use karte hain jise algorithm kehte hain. Yeh dekhta hai ki tum kis pe tap karte ho, kya like karte ho aur kahan rukte ho, phir waisa hi aur content dikhata hai taaki tum zyada der tike raho. Isiliye cricket ki ek clip dekhte-dekhte ek ghanta nikal jaata hai. Iska matlab yeh bhi hai ki shocking, daravne ya badha-chadha ke banaye videos tezi se failte hain, kyunki log unhe ruk ke dekhte hain. Kisi video pe lakhon views hone se woh sach nahi ho jaata. Health, body ya bade hone wale sawaalon ke liye feed mein jo bhi aa jaaye uspe bharosa mat karo; mummy-papa, teacher, doctor ya kisi trusted source se pucho.

h.en: When something online is not meant for you
h.hg: Jab online koi cheez tumhare liye bani hi nahi ho

body.en: Some pictures and videos on the internet are made only for adults. They can pop up by accident through an ad, a link, a game chat or a forwarded message. They are acted and edited, and they do not show how real people, bodies or relationships are. If you see something like this, or anything that leaves you scared, confused or uncomfortable, close it and tell a trusted adult such as a parent, teacher or school counsellor. You are not in trouble and you did nothing wrong. If any person sends you such things or asks you to keep it secret, tell an adult straight away or call 1098.
body.hg: Internet pe kuch photos aur videos sirf adults ke liye banaye jaate hain. Yeh kisi ad, link, game chat ya forwarded message se galti se saamne aa sakte hain. Inmein acting aur editing hoti hai, aur yeh nahi dikhate ki real log, bodies ya relationships kaise hote hain. Agar tumhe aisa kuch dikhe, ya kuch bhi aisa jisse dar, confusion ya uncomfortable feel ho, toh use band karo aur kisi trusted adult ko batao, jaise mummy-papa, teacher ya school counsellor. Tum kisi trouble mein nahi ho aur tumne kuch galat nahi kiya. Agar koi insaan tumhe aisi cheezein bheje ya ise secret rakhne ko bole, toh turant kisi bade ko batao ya 1098 pe call karo.

claim.en: If lots of people liked or shared it, it must be true.
claim.hg: Agar bahut logon ne like ya share kiya hai, toh woh sach hi hoga.

fact.en: Likes show that something caught attention, not that it is correct. Edited photos, fake news and exaggerated claims often get the most shares. Check who made it and whether a trusted source says the same.
fact.hg: Likes se bas itna pata chalta hai ki cheez ne attention kheencha, yeh nahi ki woh sahi hai. Edited photos, fake news aur badha-chadha ke kiye gaye claims aksar sabse zyada share hote hain. Check karo kisne banaya aur kya koi trusted source bhi yahi keh raha hai.

takeaways.en: Most photos and videos online are staged, filtered or edited before you see them.
takeaways.hg: Online zyadatar photos aur videos tum tak pahunchne se pehle staged, filtered ya edited hote hain.

takeaways.en: Ads and many influencer posts exist to sell something, so ask who made it and why.
takeaways.hg: Ads aur kaafi influencer posts kuch bechne ke liye hote hain, isliye pucho kisne banaya aur kyun.

takeaways.en: If adult or upsetting content appears, close it and tell a trusted adult — you are not in trouble.
takeaways.hg: Agar adult ya upset karne wala content dikhe, band karo aur trusted adult ko batao — tum trouble mein nahi ho.

activity.en: Pick one ad or reel you saw today. Write down three things that were probably done to make it look perfect (lighting, filter, editing, retakes) and one thing it wants you to buy or feel.
activity.hg: Aaj dekha hua koi ek ad ya reel chuno. Teen cheezein likho jo use perfect dikhane ke liye shayad ki gayi hongi (lighting, filter, editing, retakes) aur ek cheez jo woh tumse kharidwana ya feel karwana chahta hai.

q.en: Why do faces in ads usually look flawless?
q.hg: Ads mein chehre aksar bilkul flawless kyun dikhte hain?

options.en: Models are born without pores or marks
options.hg: Models bina pores ya marks ke paida hote hain

options.en: Lighting, make-up, retakes and editing are used
options.hg: Lighting, makeup, retakes aur editing use hoti hai

options.en: The product in the ad made their skin perfect
options.hg: Ad wale product ne unki skin perfect kar di

options.en: Cameras cannot record pimples
options.hg: Camera pimples record nahi kar sakta

explain.en: Flawless faces are produced with lighting, make-up, many retakes and editing. Real skin has pores, marks and hair.
explain.hg: Flawless chehre lighting, makeup, kaafi retakes aur editing se bante hain. Real skin mein pores, marks aur baal hote hain.

q.en: If a picture or video meant for adults pops up on your screen, the best thing to do is keep it a secret.
q.hg: Agar adults ke liye bani koi photo ya video tumhari screen pe aa jaaye, toh best yahi hai ki use secret rakha jaaye.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Close it and tell a trusted adult. Seeing it by accident is not your fault, and adults can block it and answer your questions.
explain.hg: Band karo aur trusted adult ko batao. Galti se dikh jaana tumhari galti nahi hai, aur bade use block kar sakte hain aur tumhare sawaalon ke jawab de sakte hain.

title.en: Porn Is a Script, Not a Syllabus

subtitle.en: Why pornography is unrealistic media, and what it gets wrong about bodies, consent and relationships
subtitle.hg: Pornography unrealistic media kyun hai, aur yeh bodies, consent aur relationships ke baare mein kya-kya galat dikhati hai

hook.en: Nobody learns to drive by watching a movie car chase. Learning about sex and relationships from porn is the same mistake.
hook.hg: Film ki car chase dekh ke koi driving nahi seekhta. Porn se sex aur relationships seekhna bhi wahi galti hai.

objectives.en: Describe pornography as scripted, edited media made for adult viewers.
objectives.hg: Bata paana ki pornography adults ke liye bana scripted aur edited media hai.

objectives.en: List what it leaves out or distorts about bodies, consent and feelings.
objectives.hg: Gina paana ki yeh bodies, consent aur feelings ke baare mein kya chhod deti hai ya tod-marod ke dikhati hai.

objectives.en: Know respectful ways to handle curiosity and pressure from friends.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki curiosity aur doston ke pressure ko samajhdaari se kaise handle karein.

h.en: Curiosity is normal. The content is not a teacher.
h.hg: Curiosity normal hai. Par yeh content teacher nahi hai.

body.en: Pornography, or porn, is video, images or writing made to sexually arouse adult viewers. It is made for adults, and showing it to anyone under 18 is an offence in India. Still, many teenagers come across it, often by accident through pop-ups, forwards or group chats, and some go looking because they have questions nobody is answering. Being curious about sex in your teens is a normal part of development; it does not make you dirty or bad. The problem is not your curiosity. The problem is that porn was never designed to give accurate answers.
body.hg: Pornography ya porn aise videos, images ya likha hua content hai jo adult viewers ko sexually arouse karne ke liye banaya jaata hai. Yeh adults ke liye banta hai, aur India mein 18 se kam umar ke kisi ko bhi ise dikhana offence hai. Phir bhi bahut teenagers ke saamne yeh aa jaata hai — aksar galti se, pop-ups, forwards ya group chats se — aur kuch khud dhoondhte hain kyunki unke sawaalon ka jawab koi nahi de raha. Teens mein sex ko leke curious hona development ka normal hissa hai; isse tum gande ya bure nahi ho jaate. Problem tumhari curiosity nahi hai. Problem yeh hai ki porn sahi jawab dene ke liye kabhi design hi nahi hua.

body.en: Porn is a production, like a film or an ad. Performers are hired and chosen for a particular look. Scenes follow a script or a director's instructions, are shot over many hours with breaks, and are then cut down to a few minutes. Camera angles, lighting, make-up, editing and sometimes surgery or medication shape what viewers see. Sounds and reactions are acted. What looks spontaneous and effortless is planned work. Some content is also made or uploaded without the consent of the people in it, which is abuse, not entertainment. A stunt scene is not a driving lesson, and this is not a relationship lesson.
body.hg: Porn ek production hai, jaise koi film ya ad. Performers ko hire kiya jaata hai aur ek khaas look ke hisaab se chuna jaata hai. Scenes script ya director ke instructions pe chalte hain, kai ghanton mein breaks le-leke shoot hote hain, aur phir kaat ke kuch minutes ke bana diye jaate hain. Camera angles, lighting, makeup, editing aur kabhi-kabhi surgery ya medication decide karte hain ki viewer ko kya dikhega. Awaazein aur reactions acting hote hain. Jo spontaneous aur effortless lagta hai, woh planned kaam hai. Kuch content usmein dikh rahe logon ki consent ke bina bhi banaya ya upload kiya jaata hai — yeh abuse hai, entertainment nahi. Stunt scene driving lesson nahi hota, aur yeh relationship lesson nahi hai.

body.en: Bodies: porn shows a narrow range of body types, while real bodies vary hugely in shape, size, hair and skin, and all of that is normal. Consent: people on screen rarely ask, check in or say no, and when someone refuses, the script often turns it into a yes. In real life, pressure is not consent and no means no. Safety: protection against pregnancy and infections is usually invisible. Feelings: nervousness, awkwardness, laughter, trust and care are edited out. Gender: men are shown as always in control and women as always willing, which is a stereotype, not a fact about real people.
body.hg: Bodies: porn gine-chune type ki bodies dikhata hai, jabki real bodies shape, size, baal aur skin mein bahut alag-alag hoti hain, aur yeh sab normal hai. Consent: screen pe log shayad hi kabhi puchte hain, check-in karte hain ya mana karte hain, aur jab koi mana karta hai toh script aksar use haan mein badal deti hai. Real life mein pressure consent nahi hai aur na ka matlab na hai. Safety: pregnancy aur infections se protection aksar dikhti hi nahi. Feelings: nervousness, awkwardness, hansi, trust aur care edit karke hata di jaati hain. Gender: mardon ko hamesha control mein aur auraton ko hamesha ready dikhaya jaata hai — yeh stereotype hai, real logon ka sach nahi.

h.hg: Real life mein ise kaise handle karein

body.en: You never have to watch something because friends are watching; 'not interested' is a complete answer. If an adult or older person shows or sends you porn or asks for secrecy, that is a grooming warning sign, never your fault: tell a trusted adult or call 1098. Feeling confused, guilty or worried about your body after seeing porn is common; a counsellor or doctor can help. For real answers, try this app, a health worker or an Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic. Under 18, nobody can legally consent to sexual activity, and waiting is a valid choice. Never forward sexual content; it can harm others and break the law.
body.hg: Dost dekh rahe hain, sirf isliye tumhe kuch dekhna zaroori nahi hai; 'interested nahi hoon' apne aap mein poora jawab hai. Agar koi adult ya tumse badi umar ka insaan tumhe porn dikhaye ya bheje, ya baat secret rakhne ko bole, toh yeh grooming ka warning sign hai aur isme tumhari koi galti nahi: kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 pe call karo. Porn dekhne ke baad confusion, guilt ya apni body ki tension hona common hai; koi counsellor ya doctor help kar sakta hai. Real answers ke liye yeh app, koi health worker ya Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic (AFHC) try karo. 18 se kam umar mein koi bhi sexual activity ke liye legally consent nahi de sakta, aur wait karna poori tarah valid choice hai. Sexual content kabhi forward mat karo; isse dusron ko nuksaan ho sakta hai aur law bhi toot sakta hai.

claim.en: Porn shows what people actually want and do.
claim.hg: Porn wahi dikhata hai jo log actually chahte aur karte hain.

fact.en: Porn shows what a director scripted for the camera. Real people differ in what they are comfortable with, and real respect means asking, listening and accepting a no — things porn usually skips.
fact.hg: Porn woh dikhata hai jo director ne camera ke liye script kiya. Real log alag-alag cheezon mein comfortable hote hain, aur real respect ka matlab hai puchna, sunna aur na ko accept karna — jo porn aksar skip kar deta hai.

takeaways.en: Porn is scripted, edited adult entertainment, not sex education.
takeaways.hg: Porn scripted, edited adult entertainment hai, sex education nahi.

takeaways.en: It distorts bodies, skips consent and hides feelings and safety.
takeaways.hg: Yeh bodies ko distort karta hai, consent skip karta hai aur feelings aur safety chhupa deta hai.

takeaways.en: Curiosity is normal; reliable sources and trusted adults give real answers.
takeaways.hg: Curiosity normal hai; real answers reliable sources aur trusted adults se milte hain.

activity.en: Think of one film stunt that would be dangerous to copy in real life. Then write two things porn leaves out that real, respectful relationships need (for example, asking and listening).
activity.hg: Kisi ek film stunt ke baare mein socho jise real life mein copy karna dangerous hoga. Phir do cheezein likho jo porn chhod deta hai lekin real, respectful relationships ke liye zaroori hain (jaise puchna aur sunna).

q.en: Which description of pornography is most accurate?
q.hg: Pornography ke baare mein kaun-si baat sabse sahi hai?

options.en: A realistic record of how couples behave
options.hg: Couples real mein kaise behave karte hain, uska sachcha record

options.en: A form of sex education suitable for teenagers
options.hg: Teenagers ke liye theek sex education ka ek tareeka

options.en: Scripted, edited media made to arouse adult viewers
options.hg: Adult viewers ko arouse karne ke liye bana scripted, edited media

options.en: Private videos that are always shared with consent
options.hg: Private videos jo hamesha consent se share hote hain

explain.en: Porn is a planned production with performers, scripts and editing. It was made for adult entertainment, not to show real life or to teach.
explain.hg: Porn performers, script aur editing wala planned production hai. Yeh adult entertainment ke liye bana hai, real life dikhane ya sikhane ke liye nahi.

q.en: Being curious about sex during the teenage years is a normal part of growing up.
q.hg: Teenage mein sex ko leke curious hona bade hone ka normal hissa hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Curiosity is part of normal development and nothing to be ashamed of. What matters is getting answers from reliable sources rather than from porn.
explain.hg: Curiosity normal development ka hissa hai, isme sharam ki koi baat nahi. Zaroori yeh hai ki jawab porn se nahi, reliable sources se liye jaayein.

title.en: Reality Check: Body Image, Consent Myths and Your Feed
title.hg: Reality Check: Body Image, Consent Myths Aur Tumhari Feed

subtitle.en: How porn, influencers and algorithms shape expectations — and when viewing becomes a problem
subtitle.hg: Porn, influencers aur algorithms expectations kaise banate hain — aur dekhna kab problem ban jaata hai

hook.en: Your feed has opinions about your body, your worth and what 'everyone' is doing. None of them were fact-checked.
hook.hg: Tumhari feed ke paas tumhari body, tumhari worth aur 'sab kya kar rahe hain' pe dher saare opinions hain. Unmein se ek bhi fact-check nahi hua.

objectives.en: Explain how sexualised media distorts body image and ideas about consent and gender.
objectives.hg: Samjha paana ki sexualised media body image aur consent aur gender ki samajh ko kaise bigaadta hai.

objectives.en: Recognise parasocial relationships and influencer misinformation about bodies and sex.
objectives.hg: Parasocial relationships aur bodies aur sex pe influencers ki misinformation ko pehchaan paana.

objectives.en: Identify signs of compulsive use and where to get help.
objectives.hg: Compulsive use ke signs aur help kahan milegi, yeh pehchaan paana.

body.en: Performers and influencers are selected, lit, filtered and edited, and some have had cosmetic procedures. Seeing them daily makes rare looks feel like the standard. Studies have repeatedly linked heavy exposure to idealised and sexualised images with more body dissatisfaction in both girls and boys. Common worries include breast or penis size, genital appearance, body hair, skin colour, muscles and weight. In reality, genitals, bodies and body hair vary widely, and that variation is healthy. Sudden extra hair growth, especially with irregular periods, is worth a doctor's check. If worry about your body is affecting eating, mood or going out, speak to a doctor or counsellor; Tele-MANAS is on 14416.
body.hg: Performers aur influencers chhaant ke chune jaate hain, unpe lighting, filters aur editing lagti hai, aur kuch ne cosmetic procedures bhi karwaye hote hain. Roz unhe dekhne se rare looks hi standard lagne lagte hain. Studies mein baar-baar dikha hai ki idealised aur sexualised images ka heavy exposure body dissatisfaction se juda hai — ladkiyon aur ladkon dono mein. Common worries hain: breast ya penis size, genitals ka look, body hair, skin colour, muscles aur weight. Reality mein genitals, bodies aur body hair bahut vary karte hain, aur yeh variation healthy hai. Agar baal achanak zyada ugne lagein, khaaskar irregular periods ke saath, toh doctor se check karwana sahi hai. Agar body ki tension ka asar khaane, mood ya bahar nikalne pe pad raha hai, toh doctor ya counsellor se baat karo; Tele-MANAS ka number 14416 hai.

h.hg: Screen se seekhe hue consent ke myths

body.en: Porn and many films repeat the same false lessons: that silence means yes, that a no is an invitation to keep trying, that persistence is romantic, and that nobody needs to ask. In real life, consent is a clear, voluntary yes that can be withdrawn at any moment; pressure, guilt-tripping, intoxication or fear cancel it. Screen stereotypes hurt everyone: boys learn they must always be confident and in charge, girls learn their role is to please. Legally, a person under 18 cannot consent to sexual activity in India, whatever was said. Doing to another person what you saw on screen, without their agreement, is harm.
body.hg: Porn aur kaafi films wahi jhoothe lessons repeat karti hain: ki chuppi ka matlab haan hai, ki na ka matlab hai koshish jaari rakho, ki peeche pade rehna romantic hai, aur ki puchne ki zaroorat hi nahi. Real life mein consent ek clear, apni marzi se di gayi haan hai jo kisi bhi moment wapas li ja sakti hai; pressure, guilt-trip, nasha ya dar use cancel kar dete hain. Screen ke stereotypes sabko hurt karte hain: ladke seekhte hain ki unhe hamesha confident aur in-charge rehna hai, ladkiyan seekhti hain ki unka role dusron ko khush karna hai. Legally, India mein 18 se kam umar ka insaan sexual activity ke liye consent nahi de sakta, chahe kuch bhi kaha gaya ho. Screen pe jo dekha, use kisi aur pe uski agreement ke bina try karna harm hai.

body.en: A parasocial relationship is a one-sided bond: you feel you know a creator, streamer or celebrity, but they do not know you. It is common and usually harmless, yet it makes their advice feel like a friend's. That matters when creators push claims about 'semen retention' powers, testosterone boosters, 'alpha' dating rules, vaginal tightening or detox products. Check four things: are they a qualified, registered health professional, what are they selling, do they promise fast or guaranteed results, and do reliable sources such as WHO or a doctor agree? Confidence, followers and a blue tick are not qualifications.
body.hg: Parasocial relationship ek one-sided bond hai: tumhe lagta hai tum kisi creator, streamer ya celebrity ko jaante ho, lekin woh tumhe nahi jaante. Yeh common hai aur aksar harmless, phir bhi isse unki advice kisi dost ki advice jaisi lagne lagti hai. Yeh tab matter karta hai jab creators 'semen retention' ki powers, testosterone boosters, 'alpha' dating rules, vaginal tightening ya detox products ke claims bechte hain. Chaar cheezein check karo: kya woh qualified, registered health professional hain, woh kya bech rahe hain, kya woh fast ya guaranteed results ka promise karte hain, aur kya WHO ya doctor jaise reliable sources bhi yahi kehte hain? Confidence, followers aur blue tick koi qualification nahi hain.

body.en: Many people who view porn do not develop a problem. Signs to take seriously: watching more or longer than you meant to, using it mainly to escape stress, loneliness or boredom, losing sleep or study time, needing more extreme content, failed attempts to cut down, or feeling distressed afterwards. Experts still debate whether 'addiction' is the right word, but compulsive use is real and help works. Practical steps include keeping the phone out of the bedroom at night, noticing your triggers, and filling that time with sport or people. A counsellor, doctor or Tele-MANAS (14416) can help without judgement. Shame keeps the cycle going; talking breaks it.
body.hg: Porn dekhne wale bahut logon ko koi problem nahi hoti. In signs ko seriously lo: jitna socha tha usse zyada ya der tak dekhna, ise mainly stress, akelepan ya boredom se bhaagne ke liye use karna, neend ya padhai ka time khona, aur zyada extreme content ki zaroorat padna, kam karne ki fail koshishein, ya baad mein distressed feel karna. Experts mein ab bhi debate hai ki 'addiction' sahi word hai ya nahi, lekin compulsive use real hai aur help kaam karti hai. Practical steps: raat ko phone bedroom se bahar rakhna, apne triggers notice karna, aur us time ko sport ya logon ke saath bharna. Counsellor, doctor ya Tele-MANAS (14416) bina judge kiye help kar sakte hain. Sharam is cycle ko chalaye rakhti hai; baat karna ise todta hai.

claim.en: When someone says no, it really means 'try harder'.
claim.hg: Jab koi na bolta hai, toh actually uska matlab hota hai 'aur try karo'.

fact.en: A no means stop. Continuing to push after a refusal is pressure, not romance, and agreement given under pressure is not consent.
fact.hg: Na ka matlab hai ruk jao. Mana karne ke baad bhi push karte rehna pressure hai, romance nahi, aur pressure mein di gayi haan consent nahi hoti.

takeaways.en: Bodies on screen are selected and edited; real bodies and genitals vary widely and that is healthy.
takeaways.hg: Screen wali bodies selected aur edited hoti hain; real bodies aur genitals bahut vary karte hain aur yeh healthy hai.

takeaways.en: Consent is a clear, voluntary yes that can be withdrawn — never silence, pressure or persistence.
takeaways.hg: Consent ek clear, apni marzi ki haan hai jo wapas li ja sakti hai — chuppi, pressure ya peeche padna kabhi nahi.

takeaways.en: Check a creator's qualifications and motives, and get help early if viewing feels out of control.
takeaways.hg: Creator ki qualification aur motive check karo, aur agar dekhna out of control lage toh jaldi help lo.

activity.en: Open your most-used app and look at the first ten posts. Count how many are selling something and how many show an unedited, ordinary body. Unfollow one account that regularly makes you feel worse about yourself.
activity.hg: Apna sabse zyada use hone wala app kholo aur pehli das posts dekho. Gino kitni kuch bech rahi hain aur kitni mein unedited, ordinary body dikhti hai. Aise ek account ko unfollow karo jo tumhe baar-baar apne baare mein bura feel karata hai.

q.en: In real life, which statement about consent is correct?
q.hg: Real life mein consent ke baare mein kaun-si baat sahi hai?

options.en: Silence or not resisting counts as agreement
options.hg: Chup rehna ya resist na karna agreement maana jaata hai

options.en: If someone says no at first, persistence is acceptable
options.hg: Agar koi pehle na bole, toh peeche pade rehna theek hai

options.en: Consent given once covers every later occasion
options.hg: Ek baar di gayi consent aage har baar ke liye chalti hai

options.en: It is a clear, voluntary yes that can be withdrawn at any time
options.hg: Yeh ek clear, apni marzi ki haan hai jo kabhi bhi wapas li ja sakti hai

explain.en: Consent must be clear and freely given, and it can be taken back at any moment. Silence, pressure and earlier agreement do not count.
explain.hg: Consent clear aur bina pressure ke di hui honi chahiye, aur kisi bhi moment wapas li ja sakti hai. Chuppi, pressure aur pehle ki haan count nahi hoti.

q.en: Yash follows a fitness creator who says a ₹2,000 'testosterone booster' powder will fix his body and confidence in 30 days. What should Yash check first?
q.hg: Yash ek fitness creator ko follow karta hai jo kehta hai ki ₹2,000 ka 'testosterone booster' powder 30 din mein uski body aur confidence fix kar dega. Yash ko sabse pehle kya check karna chahiye?

options.en: Whether the creator is a qualified health professional and what they earn from the product
options.hg: Creator qualified health professional hai ya nahi, aur is product se woh kya kamata hai

options.en: How many followers the creator has
options.hg: Creator ke kitne followers hain

options.en: Whether the comments under the video are positive
options.hg: Video ke neeche comments positive hain ya nahi

explain.en: Followers and comments can be bought or filtered. Qualifications, what is being sold and promises of fast, guaranteed results tell you far more about whether to trust a health claim.
explain.hg: Followers aur comments khareede ya filter kiye ja sakte hain. Kisi health claim pe trust karna hai ya nahi, yeh qualification, kya becha ja raha hai aur fast, guaranteed results ke promises se kahin behtar pata chalta hai.

title.en: Adult Reality: Porn, Intimacy and Paid Attention
title.hg: Adult Reality: Porn, Intimacy Aur Paid Attention

subtitle.en: What adult media leaves out, how it affects relationships, and the ethics and law every adult should know
subtitle.hg: Adult media kya chhod deta hai, relationships pe iska kya asar hota hai, aur woh ethics aur law jo har adult ko pata hona chahiye

hook.en: Being an adult does not turn porn into a documentary. It is still a performance, and real intimacy runs on different rules.
hook.hg: Adult ho jaane se porn documentary nahi ban jaata. Woh ab bhi ek performance hai, aur real intimacy alag rules pe chalti hai.

objectives.en: Compare on-screen sex with how adult bodies and intimacy actually work.
objectives.hg: On-screen sex ko is baat se compare kar paana ki adult bodies aur intimacy actually kaise kaam karti hain.

objectives.en: Recognise paid parasocial intimacy and sexual-health misinformation aimed at adults.
objectives.hg: Paid parasocial intimacy aur adults ko target karne wali sexual-health misinformation ko pehchaan paana.

objectives.en: Understand the ethical and legal lines around sexual content and where to get help for compulsive use.
objectives.hg: Sexual content se judi ethical aur legal lines samajhna aur jaanna ki compulsive use ke liye help kahan milegi.

body.en: Real adult intimacy looks different from the edited version. Arousal takes time and varies with stress, sleep, mood and trust. Erections come and go; natural lubrication varies, and using lubricant is ordinary, not a failure. Many people do not reach orgasm every time, and for many women penetration alone does not lead to it. Duration on screen is created by cuts and, sometimes, medication. Bodies make noises; people pause, laugh, talk and change their minds. Condoms and contraception, absent on screen, are part of real life. Measuring yourself or a partner against a performance is a common source of anxiety, and anxiety itself interferes with sexual response.
body.hg: Adults ki real intimacy edited version se alag dikhti hai. Arousal mein time lagta hai aur woh stress, neend, mood aur trust ke saath badalta hai. Erections aate-jaate rehte hain; natural lubrication kam-zyada hoti hai, aur lubricant use karna ordinary hai, failure nahi. Bahut log har baar orgasm tak nahi pahunchte, aur kaafi women ko sirf penetration se orgasm nahi hota. Screen wali duration cuts aur kabhi-kabhi medication se banayi jaati hai. Bodies awaazein karti hain; log rukte hain, hanste hain, baat karte hain aur mann badal lete hain. Condoms aur contraception, jo screen pe gayab hote hain, real life ka hissa hain. Khud ko ya partner ko kisi performance se naapna anxiety ki common wajah hai, aur anxiety khud sexual response mein rukawat daalti hai.

h.hg: Assume karne se better hai baat karna

body.en: Porn teaches assumptions; relationships need conversation. A partner is not obliged to like, try or copy anything seen on screen, and asking is not awkwardness, it is respect. Useful questions are simple: what feels comfortable, what is off-limits, what protection are we using, and how do we tell each other to stop. If one partner's viewing bothers the other, treat it as a conversation about needs and boundaries rather than an accusation. Secrecy and comparison damage trust more than the topic itself. Being married does not create consent; every person can say no to any act at any time, and that no has to be respected.
body.hg: Porn assume karna sikhata hai; relationships ko conversation chahiye. Partner pe koi obligation nahi hai ki screen pe dekhi koi cheez use pasand aaye, woh try kare ya copy kare, aur puchna awkwardness nahi, respect hai. Kaam ke sawaal simple hain: kya comfortable lagta hai, kya off-limits hai, hum kaun-si protection use kar rahe hain, aur ek-dusre ko rukne ke liye kaise bolenge. Agar ek partner ka porn dekhna dusre ko khatakta hai, toh ise ilzaam nahi, needs aur boundaries ki conversation ki tarah lein. Secrecy aur comparison trust ko is topic se kahin zyada damage karte hain. Shaadi ho jaane se consent apne aap nahi ban jaati; har insaan kisi bhi time kisi bhi act ke liye na bol sakta hai, aur us na ka respect karna zaroori hai.

body.en: Subscription platforms, live streams and chat apps sell a feeling of closeness: a creator replies, uses your name, seems to care. That is a parasocial relationship with a price tag. The warmth may be professional, the account may be run by a team, and spending more does not turn it into a mutual relationship. Watch your budget and your loneliness honestly. Adult feeds are also full of 'sexologists', coaches and supplement sellers promising size increase, lasting 'stamina' or guaranteed cures. Real treatment for erection, ejaculation, pain or desire concerns comes from a registered doctor, not from a discount code.
body.hg: Subscription platforms, live streams aur chat apps closeness ki feeling bechte hain: creator reply karta hai, aapka naam leta hai, lagta hai use parwah hai. Yeh price tag wala parasocial relationship hai. Woh warmth professional ho sakti hai, account koi team chala rahi ho sakti hai, aur zyada kharch karne se yeh mutual relationship nahi ban jaata. Apne budget aur apne akelepan, dono pe honestly nazar rakhein. Adult feeds aise 'sexologists', coaches aur supplement sellers se bhi bhari hoti hain jo size badhane, lamba 'stamina' ya guaranteed ilaaj ka promise karte hain. Erection, ejaculation, pain ya desire wali problems ka real treatment registered doctor se milta hai, discount code se nahi.

body.en: Ask where content comes from. Leaked clips, hidden-camera videos, 'revenge' uploads and deepfakes are abuse of a real person; watching and sharing them adds to the harm. In India, publishing or forwarding sexually explicit material electronically, and capturing or sharing someone's private images without consent, are offences. Any sexual content involving a person under 18 is child sexual abuse material: viewing, storing or sharing it is a serious crime; report it at cybercrime.gov.in. If your own viewing feels out of control, affects work, sleep or your relationship, or keeps escalating, a psychiatrist, clinical psychologist or Tele-MANAS (14416) can help. Laws can change; this is education, not legal advice.
body.hg: Puchiye ki content aaya kahan se hai. Leaked clips, hidden-camera videos, 'revenge' uploads aur deepfakes kisi real insaan ka abuse hain; inhe dekhna aur share karna us harm ko aur badhata hai. India mein sexually explicit material ko electronically publish ya forward karna, aur kisi ki private images bina consent ke capture ya share karna offences hain. 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan wala sexual content child sexual abuse material hai: use dekhna, store karna ya share karna serious crime hai, aur uski report cybercrime.gov.in pe karni chahiye. Agar aapka apna dekhna out of control lage, kaam, neend ya relationship pe asar daale, ya badhta hi jaaye, toh psychiatrist, clinical psychologist ya Tele-MANAS (14416) help kar sakte hain. Laws badal sakte hain; yeh education hai, legal advice nahi.

claim.en: If my partner or I do not perform like people in porn, something is medically wrong.
claim.hg: Agar main ya mera partner porn walon jaisa perform nahi karte, toh zaroor kuch medically galat hai.

fact.en: Porn performance is produced with casting, cuts and sometimes medication. Normal sexual response varies widely between people and from day to day. If a difficulty is persistent and distressing, a doctor can assess it properly.
fact.hg: Porn ki performance casting, cuts aur kabhi-kabhi medication se banti hai. Normal sexual response har insaan mein aur har din alag hota hai. Agar koi difficulty lagataar bani rahe aur pareshan kare, toh doctor uski theek se jaanch kar sakte hain.

takeaways.en: Real arousal, duration and response vary and rarely match edited performances.
takeaways.hg: Real arousal, duration aur response badalte rehte hain aur edited performances se shayad hi match karte hain.

takeaways.en: Ask your partner rather than assume, and remember that marriage is not consent.
takeaways.hg: Assume karne ki jagah partner se puchein, aur yaad rakhein ki shaadi consent nahi hai.

takeaways.en: Non-consensual or under-18 content is abuse and a crime, and compulsive use is treatable.
takeaways.hg: Non-consensual ya under-18 content abuse aur crime hai, aur compulsive use treatable hai.

activity.en: Write down, privately, two expectations about intimacy that you picked up from screens rather than from real conversation. Next to each, note how you could check it: by asking a partner, or by reading a reliable health source.
activity.hg: Privately, intimacy ko leke aisi do expectations likhiye jo aapne real conversation se nahi, screens se seekhi. Har ek ke aage likhiye ki aap use kaise check kar sakte hain: partner se puch ke, ya kisi reliable health source se padh ke.

q.en: What best describes a parasocial relationship?
q.hg: Parasocial relationship ki sabse sahi definition kya hai?

options.en: A relationship between two people who met online
options.hg: Online mile do logon ka relationship

options.en: A long-distance relationship between adults
options.hg: Do adults ka long-distance relationship

options.en: A one-sided bond with a creator or celebrity who does not know you
options.hg: Aise creator ya celebrity se one-sided bond jo aapko jaanta hi nahi

options.en: A friendship that begins in a comment section
options.hg: Comment section mein shuru hui dosti

explain.en: In a parasocial relationship the feeling of closeness runs only one way. Paying for replies or attention does not make it mutual.
explain.hg: Parasocial relationship mein closeness ki feeling sirf ek taraf se hoti hai. Replies ya attention ke liye paise dene se yeh mutual nahi ho jaata.

q.en: If a partner does not respond the way performers do on screen, it usually means they have a medical problem.
q.hg: Agar partner ka response screen ke performers jaisa nahi hai, toh aksar iska matlab hai ki unhe koi medical problem hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: On-screen reactions are acted and edited. Real sexual response varies with the person, the day, stress and trust, and that variation is normal.
explain.hg: Screen wale reactions acting aur editing hote hain. Real sexual response insaan, din, stress aur trust ke hisaab se badalta hai, aur yeh variation normal hai.

title.en: Deepfakes, Leaks and Sextortion: Your Action Plan
title.hg: Deepfakes, Leaks Aur Sextortion: Tumhara Action Plan

subtitle.en: AI-made intimate images, non-consensual sharing and online blackmail — and exactly how to report
subtitle.hg: AI se bani intimate images, bina consent ki sharing aur online blackmail — aur exactly report kaise karein

hook.en: It takes an app thirty seconds to fake a photo. It takes one forward to hurt a real person. Here is how to protect yourself and others.
hook.hg: Ek app ko fake photo banane mein tees second lagte hain. Kisi real insaan ko hurt karne ke liye ek forward kaafi hai. Jaano khud ko aur dusron ko kaise protect karna hai.

objectives.en: Explain what deepfakes and AI-generated intimate images are and why creating or sharing them is abuse.
objectives.hg: Samjha paana ki deepfakes aur AI-generated intimate images kya hain aur inhe banana ya share karna abuse kyun hai.

objectives.en: Recognise how sextortion works and the steps that stop it.
objectives.hg: Pehchaan paana ki sextortion kaise kaam karta hai aur kaun-se steps use rokte hain.

objectives.en: Know where and how to report in India.
objectives.hg: Jaanna ki India mein report kahan aur kaise karni hai.

body.en: A deepfake is a photo, video or voice clip created or altered with AI so that a person appears to do or say something they never did. 'Nudify' apps and face-swap tools can turn an ordinary school photo or profile picture into a fake sexual image. The image is fake; the humiliation, fear and bullying are real. The person shown did nothing wrong, even if the original photo was public. Making, keeping or sharing such an image is abuse and can be an offence under India's IT Act and other laws. If the person shown is under 18, it is treated as child sexual abuse material.
body.hg: Deepfake aisi photo, video ya voice clip hai jo AI se banayi ya badli gayi ho, taaki lage ki kisi insaan ne woh kiya ya kaha jo usne kabhi nahi kiya. 'Nudify' apps aur face-swap tools school ki kisi ordinary photo ya profile picture ko fake sexual image mein badal sakte hain. Image fake hoti hai; humiliation, dar aur bullying real hoti hai. Jiski photo hai usne kuch galat nahi kiya, chahe original photo public hi kyun na ho. Aisi image banana, rakhna ya share karna abuse hai aur India ke IT Act aur dusre laws ke under offence ho sakta hai. Agar image mein dikh raha insaan 18 se kam umar ka hai, toh use child sexual abuse material maana jaata hai.

body.en: Non-consensual image sharing means passing on someone's private or sexual image without their permission, whether it was sent in trust, taken secretly, stolen or faked. Each forward creates a new copy that can never be fully recalled. 'I only sent it to one friend' and 'everyone already had it' are not defences. If it reaches you: do not open it again, do not forward it, do not save it, and say clearly in the group that it must stop. Then tell a trusted adult. Blaming the person in the picture protects the people who shared it. The breach of trust is the wrong.
body.hg: Non-consensual image sharing ka matlab hai kisi ki private ya sexual image uski permission ke bina aage badhana — chahe woh trust mein bheji gayi ho, chupke se li gayi ho, chori hui ho ya fake banayi gayi ho. Har forward ek nayi copy banata hai jo kabhi poori tarah wapas nahi li ja sakti. 'Maine toh bas ek dost ko bheji' aur 'sabke paas pehle se thi' koi defence nahi hain. Agar woh tum tak pahunche: dobara mat kholo, forward mat karo, save mat karo, aur group mein clearly bolo ki yeh band hona chahiye. Phir kisi trusted adult ko batao. Photo wale insaan ko blame karna share karne walon ko bachata hai. Galti trust todne wale ki hai.

body.en: Sextortion is blackmail using sexual images. A common pattern: a stranger with an attractive profile chats warmly, moves quickly to a private app, asks for an intimate photo or a video call, and secretly records it. Sometimes they edit your face onto a fake image. Then come threats: pay money, or send more images, or it goes to your family and followers. Paying or sending more almost always leads to more demands. Stop replying, do not pay, do not send anything, and do not delete the chat or account details. Tell a trusted adult the same day. People of every gender are targeted, and being tricked is not a crime.
body.hg: Sextortion sexual images ke through kiya gaya blackmail hai. Ek common pattern: attractive profile wala koi stranger pyaar se chat karta hai, jaldi kisi private app pe le jaata hai, intimate photo ya video call maangta hai, aur chupke se record kar leta hai. Kabhi-kabhi woh bas tumhara chehra kisi fake image pe chipka dete hain. Phir dhamkiyan aati hain: paise do, ya aur images bhejo, warna yeh tumhari family aur followers tak jaayega. Paise dene ya aur bhejne se lagbhag hamesha demands aur badhti hain. Reply karna band karo, paise mat do, kuch mat bhejo, aur chat ya account details delete mat karo. Usi din kisi trusted adult ko batao. Har gender ke log target hote hain, aur dhokha kha jaana koi crime nahi hai.

body.en: First, keep the evidence where it is: note the username, profile link, phone number or UPI ID and the dates, and leave the chat undeleted. Do not forward or re-save a sexual image of anyone under 18, even as proof. Second, report: online at cybercrime.gov.in, by phone on 1930, at a police station, or through Child Helpline 1098 if you are under 18; call 112 if you are in immediate danger. Third, use the platform's report button so the account and content can be removed. Take a trusted adult with you. If you feel panicked or hopeless, Tele-MANAS 14416 is free. Laws can change and this is not legal advice.
body.hg: Pehla, evidence ko wahin rehne do jahan woh hai: username, profile link, phone number ya UPI ID aur dates note kar lo, aur chat delete mat karo. 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ki sexual image ko proof ke taur pe bhi forward ya dobara save mat karo. Doosra, report karo: online cybercrime.gov.in pe, phone se 1930 pe, police station mein, ya agar tum 18 se kam ho toh Child Helpline 1098 ke through; agar turant khatra ho toh 112 pe call karo. Teesra, platform ka report button use karo taaki account aur content hataya ja sake. Kisi trusted adult ko saath rakho. Agar panic ho ya koi umeed na dikhe, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai. Laws badal sakte hain aur yeh legal advice nahi hai.

claim.en: Only people who send nudes get targeted by deepfakes or sextortion.
claim.hg: Deepfake ya sextortion ka target wahi bante hain jo apni nudes bhejte hain.

fact.en: Anyone with a photo online can be targeted, because AI tools can create a fake sexual image from an ordinary picture. The blame lies with the person who makes, shares or threatens, never with the person shown.
fact.hg: Jiski bhi photo online hai woh target ban sakta hai, kyunki AI tools ordinary picture se fake sexual image bana sakte hain. Blame uska hai jo banata, share karta ya dhamkata hai — jiski photo hai, uska kabhi nahi.

takeaways.en: Making or sharing a real or fake intimate image of someone without consent is abuse, and if that person is under 18, saving or forwarding such an image is a serious crime even if they agreed.
takeaways.hg: Kisi ki real ya fake intimate image uske consent ke bina banana ya share karna abuse hai, aur agar woh insaan 18 se kam umar ka hai, toh aisi image save ya forward karna serious crime hai, chahe usne haan boli ho.

takeaways.en: In sextortion: stop replying, do not pay, do not send more, do not delete the chat, and tell a trusted adult.
takeaways.hg: Sextortion mein: reply band karo, paise mat do, aur kuch mat bhejo, chat delete mat karo, aur trusted adult ko batao.

takeaways.en: Report at cybercrime.gov.in, 1930, the police or 1098, with a trusted adult beside you.
takeaways.hg: Trusted adult ke saath cybercrime.gov.in, 1930, police ya 1098 pe report karo.

activity.en: Check the privacy settings of one social account today: who can see your photos, who can message you and who can tag you. Then decide which trusted adult you would tell first if someone threatened you online.
activity.hg: Aaj apne kisi ek social account ki privacy settings check karo: tumhari photos kaun dekh sakta hai, tumhe message kaun kar sakta hai aur tag kaun kar sakta hai. Phir decide karo ki agar koi tumhe online dhamkaye toh sabse pehle kis trusted adult ko bataoge.

q.en: Ananya, 14, gets a message: 'Send ₹3,000 or your edited photo goes to your whole class.' What is the safest first move?
q.hg: 14 saal ki Ananya ko message aata hai: '₹3,000 bhejo, warna tumhari edited photo poori class ko jaayegi.' Sabse safe pehla step kya hai?

options.en: Pay once so that the person goes away
options.hg: Ek baar paise de dena taaki woh peecha chhod de

options.en: Delete her account and all chats immediately
options.hg: Turant apna account aur saari chats delete kar dena

options.en: Stop replying, keep the chat, and tell a trusted adult so they can report it
options.hg: Reply band karna, chat rehne dena, aur trusted adult ko batana taaki woh report kar sakein

explain.en: Paying usually brings more demands, and deleting removes what is needed to trace the account. Silence towards the blackmailer plus a trusted adult and a report is what stops it.
explain.hg: Paise dene se aksar demands aur badhti hain, aur delete karne se woh info mit jaati hai jisse account trace ho sakta hai. Blackmailer ko reply na karna, trusted adult ko batana aur report karna hi ise rokta hai.

q.en: If a sexual image of a classmate under 18 reaches your phone, forwarding it to a teacher as proof is the right step.
q.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ke kisi classmate ki sexual image tumhare phone pe aa jaaye, toh proof ke taur pe use teacher ko forward karna sahi step hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Forwarding creates another copy and can itself be an offence. Tell the teacher or another trusted adult in person and let them report it; do not forward or save the image.
explain.hg: Forward karne se ek aur copy banti hai aur yeh khud offence ho sakta hai. Teacher ya kisi trusted adult ko in person batao aur unhe report karne do; image ko forward ya save mat karo.

warning.en: If someone is threatening to share intimate images of you, you are not alone and it is not your fault. Do not pay and do not send more. Tell a trusted adult and report at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930; if you are under 18 you can call 1098. If you feel unsafe or think of harming yourself, call 112 or Tele-MANAS 14416 now.
warning.hg: Agar koi tumhari intimate images share karne ki dhamki de raha hai, toh tum akele nahi ho aur yeh tumhari galti nahi hai. Paise mat do aur kuch aur mat bhejo. Trusted adult ko batao aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report karo; agar tum 18 se kam ho toh 1098 pe call kar sakte ho. Agar unsafe feel ho ya khud ko hurt karne ka khayal aaye, toh abhi 112 ya Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo.

title.en: What the Screen Hides: Exploitation Behind Porn and Paid Sex
title.hg: Screen Kya Chhupati Hai: Porn aur Paid Sex ke Peeche ka Exploitation

subtitle.en: Consent you cannot verify, trafficking, the law on sex work, and how to report abuse
subtitle.hg: Aisa consent jo tum verify nahi kar sakte, trafficking, sex work ka law, aur abuse report kaise karein

hook.en: A video cannot tell you whether the person in it agreed, was paid, was threatened, or is even an adult. This lesson is about the people behind the screen and behind the price.
hook.hg: Koi video tumhe yeh nahi bata sakta ki usme dikh raha insaan agree tha, use paise mile the, use dhamkaya gaya tha, ya woh adult bhi hai ya nahi. Yeh lesson un logon ke baare mein hai jo screen ke peeche aur price ke peeche hain.

objectives.en: Explain why consent cannot be judged from a video.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki video dekhkar consent judge kyun nahi kiya ja sakta.

objectives.en: Describe how trafficking and coercion work, and the broad legal position of sex work in India.
objectives.hg: Bata sako ki trafficking aur coercion kaise kaam karte hain, aur India mein sex work ki broad legal position kya hai.

objectives.en: Know how to report abuse material and suspected trafficking without spreading the harm.
objectives.hg: Jaan sako ki abuse material aur suspected trafficking ko harm phailaye bina kaise report karte hain.

h.en: You cannot see consent on a screen

body.en: Some pornography is made by consenting adults under contract. Some is not, and nobody knows how much, especially among chat-group clips and free sites. It includes hidden-camera recordings, private videos uploaded by ex-partners, hacked or leaked clips, recorded sexual assault, and scenes with people who were tricked, threatened, indebted or under 18. Some agreed to filming but never to publication. A viewer cannot tell these apart: a smile or a 'verified' badge proves nothing, and labels like 'leaked' or 'hidden cam' often mean real abuse. Large sites have deleted huge numbers of videos after such content was found. For the person shown, every view and share repeats the violation.
body.hg: Kuch pornography adult performers apne consent se, contract ke under banate hain. Kuch aisi nahi hoti, aur koi nahi jaanta kitni, khaaskar chat groups aur free sites pe ghoomne wali clips mein. Isme hidden camera recordings, ex-partners ke upload kiye private videos, hacked ya leaked clips, sexual assault ki recordings, aur aise scenes shaamil hain jinme logon ko trick kiya gaya ya dhamkaya gaya tha, jo karz mein the ya 18 se kam umar ke the. Kuch log film hone par agree the, par publish hone par kabhi nahi. Dekhne wala inme farak nahi kar sakta: smile ya 'verified' badge kuch prove nahi karta, aur 'leaked' ya 'hidden cam' jaise labels ka matlab aksar real abuse hota hai. Aisa content milne ke baad badi sites ko bahut badi sankhya mein videos delete karne pade hain. Jo insaan usme dikhta hai, uske liye har view aur har share usi violation ko repeat karta hai.

h.hg: Trafficking: log kaise phansaye jaate hain

body.en: Trafficking for sexual exploitation means recruiting, moving or holding a person through force, threats, deception, debt or abuse of vulnerability, to exploit them. It rarely starts with a kidnapping. More often it begins with a job offer, a marriage promise, a romance or a relative who is paid. Control then comes through an invented debt, confiscated documents, violence, threats to family and shame. Most identified victims are women and girls from poor families, but boys, men and transgender people are trafficked too. A person who is not locked in can still be trafficked. It is a serious crime in India, and the victim's 'agreement' is no defence for the trafficker.
body.hg: Sexual exploitation ke liye trafficking ka matlab hai kisi insaan ko exploit karne ke liye use force, dhamki, dhokhe, karz ya uski majboori ka fayda uthakar recruit karna, ek jagah se doosri jagah le jaana ya kabze mein rakhna. Iski shuruaat shayad hi kabhi kidnapping se hoti hai. Zyadatar yeh job offer, shaadi ke promise, romantic relationship ya kisi aise rishtedaar se shuru hoti hai jise paise diye gaye hon. Phir control rakha jaata hai banaye hue karz, zabt kiye gaye documents, violence, family ko dhamkiyon aur sharam ke zariye. Identify hue victims mein zyadatar gareeb families ki women aur ladkiyan hoti hain, par ladkon, men aur transgender logon ki bhi trafficking hoti hai. Jo insaan taale mein band nahi hai, woh bhi trafficked ho sakta hai. India mein yeh serious crime hai, aur victim ka 'agree' karna trafficker ke liye koi defence nahi hai.

h.en: Sex work and the law in India
h.hg: Sex work aur India ka law

body.en: Adults sell sex because of poverty, debt, coercion, lack of other work, or as a choice among limited options. They include women, men and transgender people; none deserves contempt. Under the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act an adult selling sex privately is not itself a crime, but soliciting in public, running a brothel, pimping, living off another person's earnings and trafficking are. The position of customers is less settled. The Supreme Court has said sex workers are entitled to dignity and equal legal protection. Paying for sex with anyone under 18 is a serious crime under POCSO, whatever the child 'agreed'. This has not been reviewed by a lawyer; laws change.
body.hg: Adults gareebi, karz, coercion, doosre kaam ki kami ki wajah se, ya limited options mein se ek choice ke taur par sex bechte hain. Inme women, men aur transgender log shaamil hain, aur koi bhi contempt deserve nahi karta. Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act ke under kisi adult ka privately sex bechna apne aap mein crime nahi hai, par public mein soliciting, brothel chalana, pimping, kisi aur ki kamaai par jeena aur trafficking crimes hain. Customers ki legal position utni clear nahi hai. Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki sex workers ko dignity aur law ki equal protection ka haq hai. 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath paise dekar sex karna POCSO ke under serious crime hai, chahe bachche ne jo bhi 'haan' boli ho. Is summary ko kisi lawyer ne review nahi kiya hai; laws badalte rehte hain.

h.en: The risks, and what you can do
h.hg: Risks, aur tum kya kar sakte ho

body.en: People who sell sex face frequent violence from clients, controllers and sometimes police, and often cannot insist on condoms, which raises the risk of HIV and other STIs for everyone involved. Payment never buys the right to force or hurt anyone; a sex worker can refuse or stop, and assault is assault. If you come across material that looks non-consensual or shows a child, do not download, screenshot or forward it. Note where you saw it, and report on the platform and at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930. For a child in danger call 1098; for suspected trafficking call 112. Women Helpline 181, NACO 1097 and free legal aid (15100) also help.
body.hg: Sex bechne wale logon ko clients, unhe control karne walon aur kabhi-kabhi police ki taraf se baar-baar violence jhelni padti hai, aur woh aksar condom par insist nahi kar paate, jisse isme involved har insaan ke liye HIV aur doosre STIs ka risk badh jaata hai. Paise dene se kisi ko force karne ya hurt karne ka haq kabhi nahi milta; sex worker mana kar sakta hai ya ruk sakta hai, aur assault assault hi hai. Agar tumhe aisa material dikhe jo non-consensual lage ya jisme koi bachcha ho, toh use download, screenshot ya forward mat karo. Note kar lo ki woh kahan dikha, aur platform pe aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report karo. Khatre mein pade bachche ke liye 1098 pe call karo; trafficking ka shak ho toh 112 pe. Women Helpline 181, NACO 1097 aur 15100 pe free legal aid bhi help kar sakti hain.

claim.en: Someone who is paid for sex, or who appears in porn, cannot be raped.
claim.hg: Jise sex ke paise milte hain, ya jo porn mein dikhta hai, uske saath rape nahi ho sakta.

fact.en: Payment or a contract is not consent to everything. A person can refuse any act or stop at any point, and forcing them is sexual violence, whatever their work. Their right to say no is the same as anyone else's.
fact.hg: Payment ya contract ka matlab har cheez ka consent nahi hai. Koi bhi insaan kisi bhi act se mana kar sakta hai ya kisi bhi point pe ruk sakta hai, aur use force karna sexual violence hai, uska kaam chahe jo ho. 'Na' kehne ka uska haq baaki sabke barabar hai.

takeaways.en: A video cannot prove consent, age or freedom, and viewing or sharing abusive material adds to the harm.
takeaways.hg: Koi video consent, age ya freedom prove nahi kar sakta, aur abusive material dekhna ya share karna harm ko badhata hai.

takeaways.en: Trafficking usually works through deception, debt and threats, and it affects people of every gender.
takeaways.hg: Trafficking usually dhokhe, karz aur dhamkiyon ke through chalti hai, aur har gender ke log iska shikaar hote hain.

takeaways.en: Never save or forward abuse material; report it at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930, and call 1098 or 112 when someone is in danger.
takeaways.hg: Abuse material ko kabhi save ya forward mat karo; cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report karo, aur jab koi khatre mein ho toh 1098 ya 112 pe call karo.

activity.en: Privately, think about the sexual content that reaches you through groups, feeds or searches, and ask: do I actually know that everyone in it agreed to be filmed and shared? Write down one rule you will follow from now on, such as never opening 'leaked' clips.
activity.hg: Privately socho ki groups, feeds ya search ke through jo sexual content tum tak pahunchta hai, uske baare mein kya tum sach mein jaante ho ki usme dikh raha har insaan film hone aur share hone par agree tha? Ek rule likho jo tum ab se follow karoge, jaise 'leaked' clips kabhi nahi kholna.

q.en: Which statement about consent in pornography is accurate?
q.hg: Pornography mein consent ke baare mein kaunsi baat sahi hai?

options.en: Videos on well-known sites have always been checked for consent
options.hg: Well-known sites ke videos mein consent hamesha check ho chuka hota hai

options.en: If the people look relaxed, they must have agreed
options.hg: Agar log relaxed dikh rahe hain, toh woh zaroor agree rahe honge

options.en: Labels like 'leaked' or 'hidden cam' are only marketing and never real
options.hg: 'Leaked' ya 'hidden cam' jaise labels sirf marketing hain aur kabhi real nahi hote

options.en: A viewer cannot reliably tell from a video whether everyone agreed to be filmed and published
options.hg: Dekhne wala video se reliably nahi bata sakta ki har insaan film aur publish hone par agree tha ya nahi

explain.en: Nothing visible on screen proves age, free agreement to the acts, or agreement to publication. Non-consensual and under-age material has been found even on large sites.
explain.hg: Screen pe dikhne wali koi bhi cheez age, acts ke liye free agreement ya publication ka agreement prove nahi karti. Non-consensual aur under-age material badi sites pe bhi mila hai.

q.en: Rohan, 24, sees a video in an alumni chat group that appears to show a schoolgirl being sexually abused. What should he do?
q.hg: 24 saal ke Rohan ko ek alumni chat group mein ek video dikhta hai, jisme lagta hai ki ek schoolgirl ka sexual abuse ho raha hai. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Not save or forward it, note the group and sender, and report at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930
options.hg: Use save ya forward na kare, group aur sender note kare, aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report kare

options.en: Forward it to a friend in the police as proof
options.hg: Proof ke taur par police wale dost ko forward kar de

options.en: Download it first so the evidence is not lost, then report
options.hg: Pehle download kar le taaki evidence na kho jaaye, phir report kare

options.en: Stay silent, since he did not post it himself
options.hg: Chup rahe, kyunki usne khud toh post nahi kiya

explain.en: Storing or forwarding sexual material of a child is itself an offence, even as 'proof'. Reporting where it appeared lets the authorities act without the abuse being copied again.
explain.hg: Kisi bachche ka sexual material store ya forward karna apne aap mein offence hai, 'proof' ke taur par bhi. Yeh report karna ki woh kahan dikha, authorities ko action lene deta hai aur abuse ki ek aur copy nahi banti.

warning.en: If you are being forced, threatened or held in debt to sell sex, or know someone who is, call 112, Women Helpline 181, or 1098 for anyone under 18. Being trafficked is a crime committed against you, not by you. Never save or forward abuse material. The legal points here have not been reviewed by a lawyer; free legal aid is available on 15100.
warning.hg: Agar tumhe sex bechne ke liye force kiya ja raha hai, dhamkaya ja raha hai ya karz mein baandhkar rakha gaya hai, ya tum kisi aise insaan ko jaante ho, toh 112, Women Helpline 181, ya 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke liye 1098 pe call karo. Trafficking tumhare against kiya gaya crime hai, tumhara kiya hua crime nahi. Abuse material ko kabhi save ya forward mat karo. Yahan ki legal baaton ko kisi lawyer ne review nahi kiya hai; free legal aid 15100 pe available hai.
